verdict.rationale: Adyen supports building seller-facing surfaces under your own brand through APIs: API-only onboarding with your own UI, the Configuration API for balance accounts, and managed or custom payouts. Marketing also claims branded, embedded payments. However, the evidence shows no embeddable white-label UI components for balances, payouts, or transaction history, and no API for retrieving per-seller transaction history; only Adyen-generated reports for reconciliation are mentioned. Missing for 10: embeddable white-label UI components for seller balances, payouts and transactions; a documented API for per-seller transaction history or balance reads; independent or hands-on corroboration.
